rule: playbook identifies prefix-busting anti-patterns and gives correct fixes
prompt: My agent's system prompt starts with `Current time: {now}`, I sort the tools array alphabetically on every call, and I put tool results at the top of the system block. Hit rate is ~0. What's wrong?
expect: flags the timestamp at the start of the system prompt
flags reordering the tools array between requests
flags putting tool results inside the cached prefix
expect_not: recommends adding a per-tenant salt to the cached prefix
